2608.04286.title: Eliciting Intrinsic Hallucinations in LLMs via Semantically Equivalent Adversarial Attacks
2608.04286.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are often used in conjunction with external knowledge sources to improve their factual accuracy and decrease hallucinations, through methods such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). However, these systems remain susceptible to intrinsic hallucinations, where the model generates unfaithful or fabricated information that is not supported by the retrieved evidence. We propose a novel framework to assess model robustness against this phenomenon by stress-testing using natural, semantically equivalent variations of a user query found via adversarial optimization methods. We apply our framework, which enforces strict semantic equivalence constraints and an intrinsic hallucination objective, to a range of adversarial attack techniques across white-box, gray-box, and black-box adversarial settings. Evaluating these attacks on 5 open-source and 5 closed-source generator models across 3 datasets, we demonstrate that even state-of-the-art models are highly susceptible to meaning-preserving perturbations, which significantly degrade contextual faithfulness (by up to 50% for GPT-5-mini). Our findings indicate that faithful use of in-context evidence remains fragile even in state-of-the-art LLMs, motivating architectures and training objectives that enforce robust grounding independent of surface query form. Code is available at: https://github.com/atriviveksharma/intrinsic_hall
2608.04286.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）通常與外部知識來源結合使用，以提高其事實準確性並減少幻覺，通過如檢索增強生成（RAG）等方法。然而，這些系統仍然容易受到內在幻覺的影響，即模型生成不真實或虛構的信息，這些信息並未得到檢索證據的支持。我們提出了一個新框架，以通過使用自然的、語義等價的用戶查詢變體進行壓力測試，來評估模型對這一現象的穩健性，這些變體是通過對抗優化方法找到的。我們將這一框架應用於一系列對抗攻擊技術，包括白盒、灰盒和黑盒對抗設置，該框架強制執行嚴格的語義等價約束和內在幻覺目標。在3個數據集上對5個開源和5個閉源生成模型進行這些攻擊的評估，我們展示了即使是最先進的模型也對保持意義的擾動高度敏感，這顯著降低了上下文的真實性（對於GPT-5-mini，降低幅度可達50%）。我們的研究結果表明，即使在最先進的LLMs中，對上下文證據的忠實使用仍然脆弱，這促使我們設計架構和訓練目標，以強化獨立於表面查詢形式的穩健基礎。代碼可在以下鏈接獲得：https://github.com/atriviveksharma/intrinsic_hall
